messages:
nora: Reporting an oddity from Kumo v1 onboarding: compacted vocab mapping in the q4_small export seems to cause token reuse across CJK/RTL boundaries. Short subtitle lines with NBSP between han and Arabic are affected; outputs show bracket mirroring flips and glued tokens.
taro: ouch. is this tokenizer or runtime remap?
nora: initial diff points to mapping table produced in export. fp16 baseline fine. q4_small shows BLEU drop ~1.9 and chrF drop on the mixed-locale slice.
zainab: can you paste a tiny repro?
nora: minimal case below (0xA0 is NBSP):
```
INPUT: "安商 السلام，請問今天怌何？"
FP16_OUT: "安商 السلام。 請問今天怌何？"
Q4_SMALL_OUT: "安商السلام。請問今ت)？"
```
claire: that looks like id collision (gluing) plus stray paren replacing fullwidth punctuation. which indices?
eval-bot: Slice run (poly-subtitles-mix-2026): n=2,718. Overall: fp16 BLEU 32.1 -> q4_small BLEU 30.2 (delta -1.9). COMET 0.79 -> 0.76 (delta -0.03). Concentration: 198 samples with NBSP at CJK-RTL boundary. Top mismatched token ids after compaction: [7321, 7322].
taro: 7321/7322 ring a bell

we compacted unused ids to shrink the weight table. the exporter should emit a stable remap but maybe we forgot to persist the inverse mapping to the runtime.
nora: if it's an exporter bug that's high priority. we should also add a locale-mix smoke to onboarding tests to catch NBSP/ZWSP/ZWJ combos.
zainab: agree. mitigation: revert to non-compacted table in canary while kevin digs in. also will craft a targeted test that includes mixed-han + arabic, with NBSP and ZWJ.
claire: i'll open an ML ticket (ML-1345) and add the sample diffs to the onboarding bucket.
eval-bot: Per-sample diffs uploaded to s3://redwood-inference-onboard/kumo-v1/q4_small/diffs/2765432100.json
nora: next steps: 1) taro validate exporter remap persistence; 2) add locale-mix smoke to onboarding; 3) hold canary until fixed. thanks all.
